text:
Maya: Quick idea  Quiet launch nudge: small drip (3 emails) for users who signed up but didn't finish onboarding. Tie into benchmark teaser and upcoming webinar. Keep tone product-led, short CTAs.

Lena: Good. Suggested cohorts: 0-72h signups (high priority), 4-14d idle, and re-engage (30-90d). For 30-90d use a softer subject line.

Carlos: For messaging: 1) Reminder + value stat, 2) Short walkthrough + link to checkpoint, 3) Benchmark teaser + RSVP. Use progress tokens for onboarding completion %.

Sam: Ops constraints: We can do micro-batches every 15 minutes within a 4-hour window. Recommend throttle 2.5k/hr for safety. Canary 3% on 0-72h cohort.

Gina: Creative: small hero + single CTA button. I'll prepare mobile-first PNG and a 120x60 hero for preview. No heavy GIFs to preserve deliverability.

Maya: A/B subject test for 0-72h: "Finish setup in 2 mins" vs "See your Redwood benchmark". Use emoji only in the second variant for AU cohort.

Lena: Also add suppression for customers flagged as "do-not-email" and recent unsubscribes. Carlos will supply list.

Sam: Ops snippet:```
campaign: quiet-nudge-q2
cohorts: ["0-72h", "4-14d", "30-90d"]
batch_interval_minutes: 15
throttle_per_hour: 2500
canary_pct: 3
window_local: "09:00-13:00"
```
Will queue the canary job tonight.

Gina: Assets will be in /marketing/campaigns/quiet-nudge/assets by EOD.

Carlos: I'll export segment lists and exclude internal test accounts. ETA tomorrow morning.

Maya: Metrics: open rate, completion click-throughs, onboarding completion delta. If completion delta <2% after 72h, pause and iterate copy.

deploy-bot: Campaign quiet-nudge-q2 created (id: cpn_qn_9021). Canary scheduled for 2026-07-01T09:00:00+00:00.

Maya: Thanks team. Ping here with any blockers.
